email.subject: Summit small back-charges from walkthrough
email.body:
Hi,

- Ridgeline Glass & Glazing: adhesive left on the lobby glazing after film removal; outside cleaning crew estimated $185.

Both are back-charges. I don't have invoices yet, so use these estimates in the log for now.

Thanks,
Dana
